title: Fix comment Edit/Delete dropdown menu clipping/overflow issue

requirements.text: Fix the comment action dropdown menu (containing Edit and Delete options) in CommentSection.tsx so it is always fully visible regardless of where the comment appears on the screen. The menu is currently being clipped or cut off due to container overflow constraints or incorrect positioning. Use a portal-based rendering approach or switch to a fixed/absolute positioning strategy that accounts for viewport boundaries (e.g., flip the dropdown upward when near the bottom of the screen, and ensure no ancestor container with overflow:hidden clips it).

quotes: Comment Edit and Delete options are not visible. It is visible only up to some line
This is a UI issue, not backend issue

acceptanceCriteria: The Edit and Delete options in the comment dropdown menu are fully visible for every comment in the list, including those near the bottom or edges of the screen.
The dropdown does not get clipped by any parent container's overflow settings.
The dropdown repositions itself (flips upward or adjusts) when there is insufficient space below the trigger button.
The fix applies consistently across all comment nesting levels (top-level comments and replies).
No regression in existing comment actions (like, report, reply) after the fix.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change backend logic — this is a frontend-only fix.
Preserve all existing comment actions (like, reply, report, edit, delete).
nonGoals: Adding new comment features or changing comment data models.
Changing the visual design or layout of the comment section beyond fixing the dropdown visibility.
